research_question: Does the five-direction neural span fail because its risk prices are incorrectly held constant across market states?
timing: States use only data through characteristic month t and interact with learned factor returns in month t+1.
validation_selection_rule: On 2000-2009 held-out industries, require both ridge HJ and mean absolute alpha to improve at least two percent versus unconditional K=5; among feasible maps choose the lowest HJ.
development_promotion_rule: On 2010-2019, require at least five-percent improvements in both ridge HJ and mean absolute alpha versus FF5 plus momentum on combined assets and held-out industries, with managed-span Sharpe no lower than the benchmark.
boundary: This diagnoses the time variation of the risk-price mapping while holding the learned K=5 state representation fixed. Failure rules out this two-state linear conditioning map, not all conditional asset-pricing models.
